summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a news release announcing a Q2 2026 earnings conference call scheduled for August 6, 2026. The call will provide updates on the Rook I uranium project construction, milestones, procurement awards, uranium sales contracting, and exploration success at Patterson Corridor East. Senior management including the CEO, CFO, and Project Director will participate. This is a routine quarterly earnings notification with no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, or capital actions. The filing is purely informational and does not indicate any transformative corporate event.
